facts.fact: Maroc Telecom's completed (2020-2022) 5,700 km terrestrial fibre cable from Morocco through Mauritania, Mali and Burkina Faso to Niger lets the Moov Africa subsidiary in Mauritania reach international bandwidth over the Maroc Telecom network (Morocco side); the document gives only the year 2022 for completion and its own published date.
